authored_by: LANE-EXEC (PREP-only round; runner-infrastructure authoring, not spec ratification)
verification_law: EVERY contract-number row below carries verification=PLACEHOLDER-PENDING-PER-SYMBOL-LANE. The numbers are DATA to scored_runner_v2 (consumed verbatim, never corrected by the runner); they are NOT verified market facts. Per-symbol lanes (nq/, fx_eb/, fx_ja/) plus the VERIFY lane must re-derive each number against committed exchange-spec evidence and replace every PLACEHOLDER marker before any real freeze. Until that happens no real scored run is possible (PREP-only, outcome-blind law; the runner additionally hard-refuses the real governance dir, so only sandbox execution can ever consume this file in this build).
pnl_law: gross_pnl_usd = direction * (exit_price - entry_price) * usd_per_price_unit(era), where usd_per_price_unit(era) = tick_value_usd(era) / tick_size(era). One trade carries exactly ONE era, chosen by the ENTRY bar timestamp (inclusive effective_from compare, UTC date); a trade straddling an era boundary uses its entry era for BOTH fills, for tick-grid rounding AND for cost conversion.
cost_law: cost_usd per side = fee_per_side_usd(tier) + (spread_ticks(stress) + slip_ticks(stress)) * tick_value_usd(era). Applied once per fill side (entry + exit).
era_law: The applicable era row for a trade is the LAST row in era_table whose effective_from <= entry bar date. 6A carries two eras (the only two-era contract in this build; D8-era-aware cost law upstream lineage); every other symbol carries a single era row.
quote_direction_law: long_base_sign is +1 for every contract in this build: a long position profits when the quoted price RISES. 6J carries an explicit quote_direction_note because its USD-per-JPY quote convention (price ~0.0067) is the classic sign-confusion trap; the runner applies the SAME formula to all symbols and the sign convention itself is under test (test_symbol_laws.py::T18).
